material.acceptance_criteria: a CI job posts more errors than the bucket allows and the log holds at most the bucket size plus one dropped-count line; gate reports 0 failed on each OS.
material.description: The relay caps each line's size but not the count: one client can still flood the log. Add a per-session token bucket in relay.rs with a dropped-count line when the bucket is empty.
material.resolution: Per-session token bucket: burst 20, refill one per 20 ticks, bounded 256-session table; dropped lines carry count on the next admitted error. CI job posts 25, checks at most 20 admitted and one dropped line. Verifier flagged a tick-rate flakiness risk on the -eq 20 check.
material.subject: Per-client rate limit on the client error relay
